class.name: RailVehicleTrainsetClassifier
class.brief_description: The rule a trainset's type is worked out by.
class.description: What a trainset is, from its vehicles - the rule [RailVehicleServer] recomputes the type of every trainset with whenever its vehicles change ([method RailVehicleServer.trainset_get_type]). This one is the core's: a wagon (a vehicle of power below 1) with the R brake delay or without G carries passengers, one with G and without R goods; both kinds make a mixed trainset and no wagon at all none. A plugin hands the server its own rule through [method RailVehicleServer.trainset_set_classifier]: a script overrides [method _classify], a C++ class [method classify].

method.name: _classify
method.description: Override to work out the type of a trainset of [param vehicles], its head first, by a rule of your own.

method.name: classify
method.description: Returns the type of a trainset of [param vehicles], its head first: by [method _classify] when a script overrides it, else by the core's rule.
